# MedicareClear

> Independent Medicare and ACA calculators and plain-language guides. Operator: Abdul Samad, Punjab, Pakistan.

Every figure is stored with its year, an official source URL, and the date it was checked (2026-10-26). The site is not affiliated with CMS, SSA, Medicare.gov, or the IRS. Calculator inputs stay in the browser.

## Source policy

- Official sources are linked on the page that uses the figure.
- Figures are updated by editing the data layer and redeploying; the checked date changes with them.
- The site does not publish search volumes, testimonials, or invented reviewer credentials.
